callout.text: Morning 6 Nov: global 1★ rotated (Leek Duck raid-bosses + ScrapedDuck live scrape) — costume Pikachu (hat+capelet) + Sinistea (bow) ENDED after Thu night; now LIVE 1★ Duskull / Frillish / Frillish (Female) / Litwick since Fri 6 Nov 6:00 AM local through the Altered Giratina window → Sun 8 Nov ~10:00 PM. Ghosty 3★ Cofagrigus / Trevenant / Dhelmise still LIVE alongside. Still LIVE: Altered Giratina 5★ + Mega Sableye → Sun 8 Nov 10:00 PM + Shadow Tornadus (Incarnate) 5★ weekends (first window → Sun 8 Nov 10:00 PM; longer package Mon 16 Nov → Tue 1 Dec). Shadow 1★ (Gastly / Totodile / Shieldon / Gible) + Shadow 3★ (Primeape / Kirlia / Drapion) per Leek Duck/ScrapedDuck (GO Hub still lists an alternate Shadow 1★/3★ and stale costume 1★ — not swapping while Leek Duck/ScrapedDuck show this set). Festival of Lights India-only saree/kurta 1★ starts Fri 6 Nov 10:00 AM India local → Sun 8 Nov 8:00 PM (not a global replacement; still upcoming at this HKT morning check). Eggs (Leek Duck Updated Sep 14) / Rocket (Updated Oct 2; Giovanni inactive) unchanged. ScrapedDuck shadow 5★ still stale on Landorus.
callout.endsAtLabel: Global 1★ → Duskull/Frillish/Litwick LIVE Fri 6 Nov 6:00 AM · ghosty 3★ + Giratina (Altered) + Mega Sableye + Shadow Tornadus first window → Sun 8 Nov 10:00 PM · Festival of Lights India Fri 6 Nov 10:00 AM–Sun 8 Nov 8:00 PM
